Tarikh | Episode 1029 | 28 July 2025 - Samudragupta
Samudragupta was a powerful Gupta emperor often called the Napoleon of India.
Samudragupta expanded the Gupta empire from Magadha, using different policies for the subjugation of North & South.
His life and military campaigns are primarily documented in the Prayag Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar Inscription), composed by his court poet Harishena.
Samudragupta was not just a warrior; he was also a patron of arts and culture, earning the title "Kaviraja" (king of poets) and being depicted playing the veena on his coins.
